summary: Master natural resource revenue management with practical reconciliation, forecasting, and disclosure tools. Build stronger control and reporting capacity today
lede: Natural resource revenue management helps public finance, treasury, and audit professionals trace and report extractive receipts. It builds practical skills in classifying royalties, taxes, dividends, and bonuses, reconciling declarations with payment records, and analyzing variances. Participants also practice forecasting receipts, designing revenue controls, and preparing disclosure and management reports from source data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with public finance, extractive revenues, or audit processes and need a more structured way to trace, reconcile, forecast, and report natural resource receipts.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with extractive revenue flows, treasury reporting, audit trails, or public finance processes. A laptop with spreadsheet software is required, and you should be ready to work through sample revenue data, reconciliation templates, and disclosure formats.
